purpose: Copy these patterns when adding creative assets. These are discovery examples, not downloaded assets and not blanket publishing permission.
rules: Create a real library.json asset entry only after the exact file has been downloaded and visually inspected.
Record the exact item URL and license snapshot or license URL; a provider-level policy alone is not enough when an item has its own terms.
Keep unknown, non-commercial, share-alike, and reference-only material out of outputs unless the project's intended use and obligations are explicitly approved.
Asset discovery informs the storyboard; it never requires a video to use a library asset.

discovery_example.what_to_add: A direct image page URL, photographer, downloaded filename, subject/style tags, and any recognizable-person, artwork, trademark, or editorial-use concern.

rights.usage_basis: Review exact item and current provider terms

entry_example.creative_notes: State framing, empty text space, visual style, visible brands/people, and crop limitations.

discovery_example.what_to_add: Direct video page URL, creator, native resolution/fps/duration, usable action and timecode, plus visible-brand/person restrictions.

rights.usage_basis: Review exact item and current provider terms

entry_example.creative_notes: Record the useful 00:00-00:05 action, crop safety, whether source audio is discarded, and any loop limitation.

discovery_example.what_to_add: Track title, artist, download date, exact attribution requirement shown by the track, duration, mood, and narration-safe section.

rights.attribution: Copy the required line exactly when applicable

entry_example.creative_notes: Record BPM/key if known, loop point, loudness, and the range that stays under narration.

discovery_example.what_to_add: Exact sound page, uploader, Creative Commons license displayed on that item, attribution text, duration, peak level, and intended action.

rights.usage_basis: Use only if the exact CC license permits the project's use
rights.attribution: Record required credit for CC BY

entry_example.creative_notes: Record onset, duration, peak, and the visual action it supports. Avoid CC BY-NC for commercial or monetized work.

discovery_example.what_to_add: Family, exact files/weights, family license file or URL, intended role, language coverage, and whether the font is bundled into a deliverable.

rights.usage_basis: Keep the exact family license with the file

entry_example.creative_notes: Record supported weights, language coverage, caption readability, and any reserved-font-name condition.

discovery_example.what_to_add: Official download source, owner/approver, version, allowed context, minimum size/clear space, and any approval requirement.

entry_example.creative_notes: Record approval owner, version, clear space, recoloring/animation rules, and required context.

discovery_example.what_to_add: Direct file page, author, exact license, required credit and link, plus a note explaining whether it remains study-only or is cleared for output.

rights.usage_basis: Style study only until exact license and project use are reviewed

entry_example.creative_notes: Describe what is being studied. Do not copy the asset itself into a rendered output.
